WHY_THIS_INTEGRATION: _обогатить refuses to rewrite upstream markup because nodes inside the React tree broke hydration (Minified React error #418), and foreign pages are streamed rather than buffered to keep TTFB at 0.2s instead of 1.2s. The injection therefore adds exactly one <script> as the last node of <body>, through a rolling tail window that holds back fewer bytes than '</body>' is long. Nothing enters <head> and nothing enters the app tree.
